why_it_moved.text: Successful Search Rate rose 0.81%, above the 0.50% bar, so the new ranker finds more successful searches.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: Latency p95 rose 3.10%, past the 2.00% margin; a heavier lambdamart_v7 model scoring each query is the likely cause, but no cut by query type was read.
why_it_moved.label: inferred

why_it_moved.text: No segment cuts were read, so which queries pay the latency cost is not known.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: A v7 build whose Latency p95 rise stays within 2.00% while Successful Search Rate keeps clearing 0.50% would flip the call.
A review that formally accepts a latency rise beyond the registered 2.00% margin in exchange for the search gain would reopen it.
